value.name: urge honoring her wishes
value.description: Rosa argues that the best way to honor her is to face the truth and let her wishes guide them forward.
evidence: the only way to truly honor her is to face the truth head-on; it's time we embrace her wishes and let them guide us forward.

value.name: Lucia agrees to trust her love
value.description: Lucia responds that although it is daunting, she will trust in her love as they uncover the truths left behind.
evidence: Lucia: "I know, Rosa; it's daunting, but her love has always been our anchor—let's trust in that as we uncover the truths she left behind."
